mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, while tetrabenazine depletes monoamines including serotonin and dopamine, creating risk of serotonin syndrome and severe CNS effects; tetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which may be inhibited by phenelzine.
action: Avoid concomitant use; if clinically essential, require minimum 14-day washout after phenelzine discontinuation before tetrabenazine initiation, with close monitoring for serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis.
